result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the meta line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text ('25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' rendered on top of each other), making both unreadable. Other elements (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel) appear intact; the partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behavior and not reported.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' title, the delivery-time text ('25–30 min') and the delivery-fee text ('€0 delivery') overlap each other, producing garbled, unreadable text ('25–3€0 delivery' style collision).
issues.suggestion: Fix the meta row layout so each text element occupies its own space: use a horizontal flex/stack row with proper spacing and separators (e.g., '25–30 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'), and ensure absolutely-positioned or fixed-width labels cannot overlap sibling text.
